name: Thermo Nunc 142485 24 well
author: Ramona Optics
notes: Catalogue 142485: Nunclon Delta treated, 5 per pack, 85 per case. 142485 is named explicitly on PSS 142485/144530, so this file's geometry is directly sourced with no part-number inference. Thermo Scientific Nunc 24-well Multidish, clear polystyrene, flat well bottom, round wells, sterile (gamma irradiated), non-pyrogenic, supplied with a vented lid. Every dimension in this file is read from the Thermo Fisher Scientific product specification sheet 'PSS 142485/144530', titled '24 ROUND WELL MULTIDISH W/LID', rev 0508, drawn 2008-05-30 (made PB, checked/approved JGC), published at https://documents.thermofisher.com/TFS-Assets/LCD/Schematics-&-Diagrams/142485-144530_0508.PDF and staged at Ramona under logs/add-labware/thermo-142470/. WARNING - THE VENDOR SHEET CONTRADICTS ITSELF: its spec table row 'NUMBER OF WELLS' reads 8, but the sheet's own title block says '24 ROUND WELL MULTIDISH', its plan view draws a 6 x 4 array of 24 round wells, and Thermo's catalogue entry for every part number on the sheet gives 'No. of Wells 24' and 'Array 4 x 6'. The '8' is a copy-paste error carried over from the 8-well rectangular multidish sheet and is ignored here; 24 wells is what this file registers. Dimension letters as lettered on that sheet: A (base length) 127.5 mm, B (base width) 85.3 mm, C (base height) 18.8 mm, G (well dia @ top) 16.3 mm, H (well dia @ bottom) 15.5 mm, J (well depth) 15.7 mm, K (well-to-well spacing) 19.6 mm. Plate height 18.8 mm is C, the base WITHOUT the lid, which is what z_reference ('top surface of plate') needs; the sheet's L (assembly height with lid) is 22.6 mm and is NOT used. Lid alone is D 127.3 x E 84.8 x F 9.9 mm. NOTE THE FOOTPRINT IS NOT ANSI/SLAS: 127.5 x 85.3 mm, against the ANSI/SLAS 1-2004 127.76 x 85.48 mm, even though Thermo's own catalogue page tags this product 'Format: SBS Standard'. Distributor listings quoting '128 x 86 mm' are rounding the drawing figures. The drawing values are used here. well_dimensions.diameter is the TOP diameter (G, 16.3 mm) per this registry's convention; the bottom (growth surface) diameter is 15.5 mm (H). Cross-check: a 15.5 mm bottom disc is 1.887 cm2, matching the 1.9 cm2 culture area per well stated on the same sheet and on Thermo's catalogue page (an older Nunc multidish catalogue table rounds it to 1.8 cm2). Suggested working volume 1.0 mL/well. A1 OFFSETS ARE DERIVED, NOT PUBLISHED: the sheet dimensions the pitch (K) and the footprint (A, B) but carries no A1-centre-to-edge dimension in any view. The offsets here assume the 4 x 6 grid is centred in both axes, which is what the plan view shows: offset_from_left_edge = (127.5 - 5 x 19.6) / 2 = 14.75 mm, offset_from_top_edge = (85.3 - 3 x 19.6) / 2 = 13.25 mm. This assumption is safe for most 24-well plates but is NOT universal - Corning's Costar 24-well mould is deliberately off-centre by 1.86 mm in the long axis (see Corning_costar_24_well_plate.json) - so these two numbers should be confirmed against a plate in hand before anything depends on them. Pitch is taken as equal in both axes: the sheet letters K once, on the row spacing, and 19.6 mm in both axes is the only value consistent with a 6 x 4 array centred inside 127.5 x 85.3 mm. BOTTOM THICKNESS IS NOT PUBLISHED by Thermo for this mould - it is not on the sheet, the catalogue page, or any Nunc multidish document found - so it is absent here rather than guessed. It is the working-distance number, so measure it before assuming a value. Surface: Nunclon Delta cell-culture treatment. Sibling part numbers on this same mould: 144530 (non-treated, clear, sterile, 1/75, named alongside 142485 on this very sheet) and 140682 (Nunclon Supra treatment). Dimensions in metres.
